describe.title: Write a context record
describe.subtitle: One concern per record, and one record per pull request.
describe.placeholder: Do not re-read CHANGELOG.md more than once in a run; cache the first read.
describe.hint: Say the thing itself, not the reason for it. The reason belongs in the rationale on the pull request, where a reviewer reads it once. In the bundle, every agent pays for it on every turn.

suggestions.changelog: Do not re-read CHANGELOG.md more than once in a run
suggestions.release: The release manager opens the release pull request; a person merges it
suggestions.order: Cut a release in this order: freeze, dry-run migrations, tag, publish
suggestions.flake: The checkout e2e suite flaked on Safari through August

describe.noGrant: A record steers. It never grants. No sentence you write here makes a denied call allowed.
describe.name: Name
describe.slugHint: The slug identifies this record and its file. You can edit it before publishing.
describe.slugInvalid: The slug needs at least two letters or digits from a to z or 0 to 9. Type a slug here if the name has none.

kind.title: What kind is it?
kind.subtitle: The kind decides how the record reaches a run and what the checks assert. It is not a label.

rule.label: rule
rule.use: An instruction you want followed, that a reasonable agent could still weigh against the task.
rule.never: It cannot grant authority, and it cannot make a denied call allowed.
rule.deliver: Compiled into the steering block of the policy bundle. must and should sit in the stable prefix of every turn. may and info are selected by relevance.

constraint.label: constraint
constraint.about: A hard boundary: require or forbid.
constraint.use: A boundary with two values and no middle: require this, or forbid that.
constraint.never: It can narrow what is allowed. It can never widen it. A require does not create the permission it requires.
constraint.deliver: Compiled into the stable prefix at whatever force it carries, and checked against every other published record on the same subject.

procedure.label: procedure
procedure.use: Steps, in order, where the order is the point.
procedure.never: A step is not an authority. Naming a governed action in step 4 does not put it on a toolbelt.
procedure.deliver: Compiled like a rule, and rendered as an ordered list so a model cannot silently reorder it.

fact.label: fact
fact.about: A checkable claim about the world.
fact.use: A claim about the world that somebody could check and find false.
fact.never: It steers nothing by itself. A fact that needs to change behaviour is a rule that cites it.
fact.deliver: Delivered as a fact context frame with provenance to this record and its commit, valid_from set to the merge time.

memory.label: memory
memory.use: Something that happened, that explains what an agent is about to see.
memory.never: It never forbids anything, and it is never evidence on its own. It is why a retry is not a regression, not proof that it was not.
memory.deliver: Delivered as a memory context frame, selected by relevance, never pinned into the prefix.

preference.label: preference
preference.use: A soft leaning, usually unfalsifiable, that you would rather have than not.
preference.never: It never blocks a call, and a run that ignored it is not a failing run.
preference.deliver: Delivered at may or info, selected by relevance, and dropped first when the window is tight.

statement.title: The statement
statement.subtitle: This is the record. Everything else about it is metadata.

drafted.title: A statement, drafted from what you wrote
drafted.body: Oxagen filled this in from your description, in this tab. No model wrote it and no run was recorded. Every line below is yours to change before anybody reviews it.

statement.empty: Write the statement before you run the checks.
statement.tooLong: The statement is {count, number} characters. The schema takes {max, number} at most.

force.label: Force
force.stable: In the stable prefix of every turn in scope. It is paid for whether or not it is relevant.
force.selected: Selected by relevance, and dropped first when the window is tight.
force.preference: A preference is soft, so it is never must or should.
force.informs: A fact or a memory informs, so its force is info.

scope.label: Scope
scope.workspaceHint: Opens on {repository} and reaches every agent in {workspace}.
scope.repositoryClosed: A repository record opens on the linked repository itself, and it may narrow what a workspace record allows, never widen it. This wizard opens pull requests on the main repository only, so the records it writes are workspace records.

effect.label: Constraint effect
effect.hint: The only two values there are. A record can never grant authority, so there is no third.

preview.label: How it will read
preview.badge: Not published. This is the preview.

statement.bundle: Merging it recompiles the workspace’s steering bundle and adds about {tokens, number} tokens to each turn it reaches. A request already recorded keeps the bundle version it was sent with, so merging this never changes what an old run carried.

checks.title: What the checks will assert
checks.subtitle: Six of them, on the pull request, before anybody can merge it.

schema.name: Schema
schema.detail: context-record/v0.1 is valid: one file, one record, one lineage.

lineage.name: Lineage uniqueness
lineage.detail: No published record may hold {lineage}. If one does, this check fails and nothing merges. Amend the published record instead of opening a second under its id.

hash.name: record_hash recomputation
hash.detail: Recomputed over the canonical bytes and compared to the file.

secrets.name: Secret and PII scan
secrets.detail: The statement, the rationale, and the evidence are scanned. A name or a key in any of them fails.

conflicts.name: Conflict against active records
conflicts.detail: Checked against every published record in the workspace. A forbid that contradicts an active require on the same subject fails.

effect.name: constraint_effect is require or forbid
effect.none: Not a constraining kind. The field is absent, which also passes.

checks.fifth: The conflict check earns the others. Two people can each write a sensible record, six weeks apart, that together say a call must happen and must not. The pull request is the only place that is caught, before either reaches a run.

pr.title: Open the pull request
pr.subtitle: People trust pull requests. That is the whole design.
pr.lead: Merge is the publication. Nothing steers until then, and the record is in force from the merge commit, not from when you wrote it.
pr.proposalKept: Proposal {proposal} is on Steering, under Proposals. Trying again opens its pull request. It does not propose a second record.

repo.unbound: This workspace has no main repository yet. Bind one in Workspace settings, then open the pull request.
repo.denied: Opening a Context PR needs Owner or Admin on the organization, or Owner or Member on the workspace.
repo.unavailable: The main repository could not be read ({code}). Nothing was written. Close the wizard and open it again to retry.

opened.title: The pull request is open
opened.subtitle: It steers nothing until it merges.
opened.noPr: The proposal is recorded, and its pull request is not open yet.
opened.passed: Every check passed. A reviewer can merge it under the workspace’s governance mode.
opened.failed: A check failed, so the pull request cannot merge. Fix the file on the branch, or close the pull request from Context PRs. Nothing is in force.
opened.running: The checks are still running. Context PRs shows them as they finish.

failure.orgRoleRequired: Opening a Context PR needs Owner or Admin on the organization, or Owner or Member on the workspace. Nothing was written.
failure.noPrincipal: Oxagen could not tell who is signed in. Sign in again and retry. Nothing was written.
failure.lineagePrOpen: A Context PR for this lineage is already open. One concern, one pull request. Change the description to name a different concern, or finish the open one first.
failure.governanceUnreadable: The main repository’s .oxagen/rules/governance.toml could not be read, so Oxagen cannot tell who may merge. Fix it on the production branch, then try again.
failure.repositoryMissing: This workspace has no main repository yet. Bind one in Workspace settings.
failure.githubRefused: GitHub refused the write. Check the GitHub App’s access to the repository and try again.
failure.gitlabRefused: GitLab refused the write. Nothing was published. Check that the project access token still has the api scope and the Developer role, then try again.
failure.gitlabCredentialRejected: GitLab no longer accepts the project access token stored for this project. Nothing was changed. Connect the project again with a new token.
failure.baseMoved: The production branch moved while the pull request was opening. Try again.
failure.proposalMoved: Another change moved this proposal first. Open it on Context PRs to see where it stands.
failure.unanswered: Oxagen did not answer. Try again.
failure.invalid: The {field} value is not one propose_record accepts. Nothing was written.
failure.pendingApproval: Opening this pull request waits for approval: access request {request}.
